summary: Non-transparent newtypes fail deserialization because deserialize_newtype_struct forwards to deserialize_any, passing the underlying value directly to a visitor expecting a newtype. The fix calls visitor.visit_newtype_struct(self), allowing the wrapper to deserialize its inner value. Reverse only ItemDeserializer's correction to exercise newtypes in tests/serde.rs, updated by this commit to deserialize B(u32) without serde(transparent). This root-level integration test requires the easy feature. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: invalid type: integer `2`, expected tuple struct B
